Why Ryan? 
 Flexibility Built for Life: Hybrid and remote work options, depending on the role
 Benefits Starting Day One: Health, dental, and vision coverage effective on your first day for you and your eligible dependents
 Support for Growing Families: 14 weeks of 100% paid leave for new parents, including adoption, plus access to a fertility assistance program
 Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off and eligibility for a four-week, company-paid sabbatical after five years of service
 Investing in Your Future: 401(k) employer match and tuition reimbursement after one year of service
  Fitness Reimbursement: Choose a monthly gym membership or eligible home fitness equipment reimbursement
 An Award-Winning Workplace: Join a culture recognized for its team member experience
 
The Senior AI Security Engineer supports the secure design, development, and deployment of AI solutions across Ryan. This role partners closely with Information Security, Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to identify and mitigate AI-specific security risks throughout the development lifecycle. The role provides technical security guidance, conducts AI security assessments and red team exercises, develops security standards and training, and supports the implementation and integration of AI security tools and controls. People 
 • Partner with Information Security, Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to support the secure adoption of AI technologies.
 • Develop and deliver training on AI security and red team methodologies and provide hands-on coaching to technical teams.
 • Build effective working relationships across technical teams and serve as a trusted security partner throughout the AI development lifecycle.

 Client 
 • Partner with teams developing AI solutions, including LLM applications, agents, RAG pipelines, and machine learning models, to provide security guidance from design through deployment.
 • Participate in design reviews and technical planning to identify security risks and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
 • Assess AI solutions using recognized security frameworks, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF, and provide prioritized remediation recommendations.

 Value 
 • Lead and participate in red team exercises for AI applications, including testing for prompt injection, jailbreaking, data and model exfiltration, insecure tool or plugin use, training data poisoning, and unsafe agent behavior.
 • Identify gaps in Ryan’s AI security posture and recommend, evaluate, and implement appropriate security controls and technologies.
 • Partner with security technology vendors to evaluate and integrate AI security capabilities, including monitoring, guardrails, data loss prevention, and access controls.
 • Develop and maintain AI security standards, review processes, checklists, and reference architectures.
 • Monitor emerging AI security threats, technologies, and regulatory requirements and incorporate relevant changes into Ryan’s security practices.

 Education and Experience 
 • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a related field, including experience securing modern application or cloud environments.
 • Experience working with AI/ML technologies, including LLM-based applications, agents, or machine learning pipelines, and associated security risks.
 • Experience with red teaming, penetration testing, or other offensive security practices.
 • Knowledge of AI security frameworks and guidance, such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF.
 • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 • Experience evaluating, implementing, or integrating security technologies and working with technology vendors.
 • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or GCP and application security technologies, including SAST/DAST, secrets management, IAM, and logging and monitoring.
 • Preferred: experience developing or supporting an AI red team or bug bounty program; experience with AI model evaluation and guardrail technologies; relevant security certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, or CISSP; or experience in security architecture or platform engineering.

 Supervisory Responsibilities 
 No direct supervisory responsibilities.
 Equal Opportunity Employer: disability/veteran 

 About Ryan 

 Build More Than a Career. Create Your Future.

 Ryan is an award-winning global tax services and software provider and the only global-scale specialist in business tax. We combine deep tax expertise with consulting, technology, advocacy, and compliance solutions to solve complex challenges and help clients pay only what they owe, freeing capital to invest, grow, and thrive.

 At Ryan, team members contribute to meaningful work for many of the world’s most respected organizations. From day one, you’ll have opportunities to solve complex problems, build deep expertise, take ownership of your work, and make a measurable impact while growing at the speed of your own ability.

 Our high-performance, people-first culture is supported by the acclaimed myRyan work environment. You’ll have the freedom to innovate, grow professionally and personally, and benefit from support that adapts to your life. Our flexible work philosophy, commitment to work-life success, and comprehensive benefits help you perform at your best. And with a team invested in your success, your contributions are recognized and celebrated.

 It’s a culture built to empower you to accelerate , transform , and win —together.
